subject: E-Commerce
title: Escrow and Buyer Protection
description: A fast breakdown of Escrow and Buyer Protection for builders.

hook.text: eBay's buyer protection holds payment in escrow until you confirm receipt. It turned stranger-to-stranger commerce safe.

buildup.text: Without escrow, buying from strangers online was terrifying. Who sends money first? What if nothing arrives?

discovery.text: PayPal's buyer protection became the standard for online trust. Get your money back if the product never arrives.

twist.text: Buyer protection is often abused. Buyers claim they didn't receive items were delivered, and platforms side with them.

climax.text: Escrow and buyer protection made peer-to-peer commerce possible but created new fraud vectors in the process.

punchline.text: Hold the money until delivery is confirmed. Escrow made buying from strangers.

quiz.question: How does escrow create trust in peer-to-peer e-commerce?
options: Payment is held until the buyer confirms receipt, protecting both parties
